name: Two-Column Brief
description: One to three pages, each with a main column of sections on the left and a tinted sidebar on the right (key facts, a callout, an optional quote). Page 1 opens with the logo, eyebrow, headline and summary; later pages get a slim running header. Every page has the brand footer (logo, website / phone, social icons, page number). An optional call to action closes the last page.
bestFor: Dense material that needs room: solution and integration briefs, onboarding and how-to guides, partner sheets, technical or pricing summaries with many concrete facts. Grows to extra pages instead of cutting important content.
guidance: Headline: title + title_accent read as one headline; put the 1-3 word payoff in title_accent (shown in blue), as in the Figma house style.
Use as few pages as the content honestly needs. Add a page rather than cutting facts a reader would miss, but never pad.
Each page holds about 280-380 words in total. Every page except the last should be nearly full; the last page should be at least half full (render reports free space at the bottom per page).
Title: 4-9 words. Summary: 2 sentences, at most 45 words. Eyebrow: 1-4 words.

Main column per page: 2-4 sections. Heading 2-6 words; body at most 60 words; 0-5 bullets of at most 14 words; rows (label/value pairs, rendered as a striped table) 0-6, label at most 5 words, value at most 14 words. Use rows for stages, steps, limits and settings; use bullets for simple lists.

Sidebar per page: heading plus 3-6 facts (label 1-4 words, value a number, name or at most 8 words), and/or a callout (title at most 7 words, text at most 40 words). Quote only if verbatim in the source; otherwise leave quote, author and role empty. Leave sidebar parts empty rather than inventing them.
Keep related material together: a section never continues across pages, so move a whole section to the next page instead.
CTA: for sales material, a demo or contact CTA. For customer guides, point to help or support from the source, or leave headline empty to hide the CTA.

eyebrow.description: 1-4 word label, e.g. "Integration guide", or empty.

title_accent.description: Last 1-3 words of the headline, shown in Salesmsg Blue, or empty.

pages.description: 1-3 pages in reading order; each page is one printed sheet.

rows.description: 0-6 label/value rows shown as a striped table.

value.description: A number, name or at most 8 words.

quote.description: Verbatim quote from the source, at most 35 words, or empty.

cta.description: Closes the last page. Empty headline hides it.

headline.description: At most 8 words, or empty to hide the CTA.

url.description: Link from the source document, or the brand website.
